press_release_title: Turner Capital Investments, LLC sponsors the MoneyShow Masters Symposium in Las Vegas, NV
press_release_text: Mike Turner, Turner Capital President, will present its latest advancement in artificial-intelligence (AI) controlled stock market trading methodology that is breaking historical records for performance and risk mitigation. Austin, TX – July 15, 2025 – Turner Capital Investments, LLC will co-sponsor the upcoming MoneyShow Masters Symposium at the Caesars Las Vegas Resort & Casino in Las Vegas, NV July 15 through July 17, 2025. Mike Turner, President, will present the company’s AI-driven trading methodology designed to grow client capital in both bull-trending markets and bear-trending markets by dynamically detecting when to enter bull-trending market cycles and when to step aside from corrections. The methodology capitalizes on the total market using major market indexes and ProShares® leveraged index ETFs giving clients the ability to grow their capital in a 1x, 2x and/or 3x growth structure. Turner Capital uses its proprietary AI-driven rules-based market momentum recognition algorithms applied to large, well-defined market indexes, to make all trading decisions. The Turner trading methodology is unique in the investing world as it ignores traditional and obsolete buy-and-hold strategies, the 60/40 portfolio strategy, and the passe’ technical chart pattern analysis that believes in the fallacy of past performance equals future returns. Purposely, the Turner trend-based methodology ignores analyst reports, company fundamentals, and individual stock picking strategies. Turner Capital focuses on the current trend of the market and relies on the mathematical fact that the current market trend will continue exactly and explicitly until it doesn’t. And unlike the typical asset management firms, Turner Capital clients know and appreciate the fact that the Turner AI-driven trading strategy has a ‘go-to-cash’ mode; meaning the methodology knows when to move out of the market and into high-yielding, safe money-market investments while waiting for the next tradable trend to ensue. This means trading decisions are unbiased and totally unemotional. The beauty of this methodology is how clinical the decision-making process is and how unaffected it is by current events. Turner Capital offers three dual-direction portfolio models The TMI-1x: This model utilizes a 50/50 mix of the S&P 500 ETF (SPY) and the Nasdaq 100 ETF (QQQ). When not capitalizing on an AI-detected trend, the model is in high-yielding money-market mutual funds. The TMI-2x: This model utilizes a 50/50 mix of the 2x S&P 500 ETF (SSO) and the 2x Nasdaq 100 ETF (QLD). When not capitalizing on an AI-detected trend, the model is in high-yielding money-market mutual funds. The TMI-3x: This model utilizes a 50/50 mix of the 3x S&P 500 ETF (UPRO) and the 3x Nasdaq 100 ETF (TQQQ). When not capitalizing on an AI-detected trend, the model is in high-yielding money-market mutual funds. Interested investors can visit the company’s website at www.turnercapital.com to start a dialog with the Turner Capital staff. The minimum account size is $100,000. Client capital is managed using individually managed accounts and not in a pooled fund. The capital is highly liquid with the ability for clients to withdraw or deposit cash at any time. Funds are custodied at Schwab. About Turner Capital Investments Turner Capital is a fiduciary asset management firm, founded in 2007 by Mike Turner. Mike Turner’s background is engineering (Civil), computer science, and finance. He is the primary architect of the science, algorithms, and math behind the analytical dual-direction methodology and software systems used at Turner Capital. He is a disciplined and formulaic trader who relies heavily upon these software systems. Mike is the author of the very popular books, 10-The Essential Rules for Beating the Market and Rule 1 of Investing . Mike is a frequent guest speaker and lecturer to large financial groups nationwide. For more information, contact: Amy Goodwin, (855) 678-8200 [email protected]

press_release_title: NATCOM: Enabling Long-Term Connectivity with Recurring International Top-Ups
press_release_text: Port-au-Prince, Haiti – NATCOM , Haiti’s premier telecommunications provider, continues to strengthen family bonds and ensure uninterrupted communication by introducing recurring international top-up functionality. This new feature allows Haitians living abroad to automatically recharge the mobile accounts of their loved ones in Haiti, bringing added convenience, consistency, and peace of mind. Seamless International Support with Scheduled Top-Ups Understanding the importance of uninterrupted mobile service for families in Haiti, NATCOM now enables users in the United States, Canada, France, Mexico, Chile, and more to schedule regular mobile recharges through trusted global partners such as Ding, Prepay Nation, Boss Revolution, Idealtel, and DT One. This automation ensures that prepaid accounts never run out of credit, eliminating the stress of manual recharges and time zone coordination. Users can configure the top-up frequency—weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly—using supported mobile apps or partner websites. All transactions are securely processed and users can monitor their top-up history through these platforms. Supporting Haitian Diaspora with Peace of Mind This new service is particularly beneficial for members of the Haitian diaspora who consistently support their families back home. By leveraging recurring top-ups, they can guarantee their loved ones remain connected, especially in emergencies or for daily communication. “Recurring international top-up is another step in Natcom’s mission to simplify global connectivity and support the Haitian community abroad,” said a NATCOM spokesperson. “We aim to offer services that not only connect people but also reduce friction in their lives.” About NATCOM Founded in 2011 as a joint venture between Viettel Group and the Haitian government, NATCOM is Haiti’s leading telecommunications provider. With a commitment to technological innovation, social impact, and customer satisfaction, NATCOM delivers comprehensive solutions across voice, data, and mobile financial services. For more information, visit www.natcom.com.ht We'll respond within 24 hours Our team is ready to help you find the perfect solution. We'll get back to you within 24 hours.

press_release_title: What Homeowners Should Know Before Taking out a Pool Loan
press_release_text: Adding a pool to a backyard can turn a home into a fun summer or year-round spot, but it’s also a big financial decision. Some homeowners use pool loans to help cover the cost of a new pool. But before jumping into a loan, it’s important to understand how much it costs to build and maintain a pool, what kind of loan might work best and how all this factors into a homeowner’s budget. Consider the cost of building a pool Basic above-ground pools, which don’t require filtration, could cost anywhere from a few hundred dollars to $1,000. More complicated above-ground pools could range in cost from $1,000 to $8,000, depending on the size and material. In-ground pools, on the other hand, are more expensive and permanent. The cost to install an in-ground pool can start at $20,000, but fancier options can push the price even higher and range from $50,000 to over $100,000. Factors like size, shape, type of materials and extras like waterfalls or built-in hot tubs all affect the final cost. Remember to think about extra costs, such as fences, a deck and landscaping, which could all add up to thousands more. Keep ongoing maintenance bills in mind Building the pool is just the beginning. Keeping it running and looking good also costs money. Homeowners need to buy pool chemicals regularly to keep the water clean and safe, which could cost $50 to $100 a month. There are also costs for maintenance, including cleaning the pool, checking the filter and making minor repairs. Other equipment — like pumps and heaters — can wear out over time and need to be replaced. Pool accessories, such as chairs, towels and toys, could also cost a pretty penny depending on the style and quantity needed. Compare loan options There are a few ways to borrow money to pay for a pool, and each option has pros and cons. Secured personal loan A secured loan is tied to something valuable the borrower owns, like a car or a house, which is used as collateral. Collateral protects the lender because if the borrower stops making payments, the lender could take the collateral to help cover the balance of the loan. Because the lender takes on less risk, a secured loan can often come with a lower interest rate and a larger loan amount than an unsecured loan. Unsecured personal loan An unsecured loan doesn’t require collateral. Instead, the lender decides if a borrower qualifies by looking at factors like their credit score, credit history and income. Since there’s no collateral to back the loan, the interest rate is generally higher than that of a secured loan. Home equity loan or home equity line of credit (HELOC) If a lender is aware that a homeowner has equity in their home, which is the market value of their home minus the mortgage, or the amount of the home’s value they own outright, they may qualify for a home equity loan or a HELOC. Home equity loans and HELOCs are secured loans using the home itself as collateral. The main difference between a home equity loan and a HELOC is that a home equity loan provides the borrower with a lump sum of money that is repaid over time in monthly installments, while a HELOC is a revolving line of credit similar to how a credit card works. With a HELOC, a person borrows money as needed during a defined period of time up to a certain limit, can repay it and borrow again, and only pays interest on what they borrow. Even if the interest rate of a home equity loan or HELOC seems low, it’s important to consider extra costs, like appraisal fees, that can raise the total cost of the loan. Most HELOCs also come with a variable interest rate, so the cost of borrowing can go up or down over time. Budget for the years to come Pools are fun — but they’re also long-term commitments. Before taking out a loan, homeowners should think about the bigger picture. Most importantly, homeowners should make sure monthly loan payments and any additional pool costs fit into their budget. Needing to cut costs on groceries, insurance or saving for the future might not be the best idea if that’s what it takes to pay for a pool. Additionally, homeowners should consider whether they will still be excited about the pool in five or ten years. Or will they still be paying for it after the excitement fades? If the latter might be true, monthly loan payments could become frustrating over time. It’s also worth thinking about a potential move in the future. If there are plans to sell the home, will a pool help or hurt the sale? Some buyers love pools, but others see them as too much work. Depending on the local market, a pool may not raise the home’s value enough to cover its cost. Dive in wisely A pool can add a lot of fun to a home, but building and maintaining it is a big financial decision. A pool loan could help make it happen, but it comes with a lot of responsibilities. From construction and upkeep to loan payments and long-term plans, it’s important to carefully think through everything. Homeowners who take the time to consider all the costs and compare loan options can look forward to enjoying their new pool to the fullest. press_release_text: 12th July 2025 Le célèbre analyste en investissement Laurent Mignon a officiellement annoncé la conclusion d’un partenariat stratégique avec la principale plateforme d’échange de cryptomonnaies Blockchain Network . En tant qu’acteur majeur du marché mondial des actifs numériques, Blockchain Network accélère actuellement son expansion sur le marché asiatique. Ce partenariat offrira non seulement aux investisseurs des analyses de marché et des stratégies de trading plus professionnelles, mais contribuera également à promouvoir le développement du commerce d’actifs numériques dans la région asiatique. Pour célébrer ce partenariat historique, Blockchain Network lancera une loterie de luxe d’un montant total pouvant atteindre 20 millions de dollars . De plus, une récompense en espèces allant de 100 à 2 000 dollars sera offerte aux nouveaux utilisateurs s’inscrivant avec le code d’invitation exclusif de Laurent Mignon , afin d’aider les investisseurs à entrer facilement sur le marché et à saisir rapidement les opportunités de création de richesse. Blockchain Network — une plateforme d’échange d’actifs numériques conforme et sécurisée, opérant sous la régulation financière mondiale. En tant que plateforme de trading conforme reconnue à l’échelle mondiale, Blockchain Network détient les licences MSB (Money Services Business) délivrées par le FinCEN (Réseau de lutte contre les crimes financiers) des États-Unis et le FINTRAC (Centre d’analyse des opérations et déclarations financières) du Canada, ainsi qu’une licence délivrée par le FCIS (Service d’enquête sur les crimes financiers) de Lituanie. Elle respecte strictement les réglementations financières en vigueur, garantissant ainsi la sécurité et la transparence des transactions. La plateforme s’engage à créer un environnement de trading de cryptomonnaies fiable, en offrant aux investisseurs du monde entier des services de trading conformes, stables et efficaces. En outre, Blockchain Network adopte des systèmes de gestion des risques avancés de KYC (vérification de l’identité des utilisateurs) et de LBC/AML (lutte contre le blanchiment d’argent), tout en utilisant des technologies de chiffrement multiples pour garantir la sécurité des actifs des utilisateurs, protégeant ainsi leurs droits avec les normes les plus élevées. L’orientation stratégique mondiale se tourne vers l’Europe, accélérant l’expansion sur les marchés régionaux Par le passé, Blockchain Network s’est principalement consacrée aux marchés des Amériques et de l’Asie, où elle a su bâtir une large base d’utilisateurs grâce à sa solide expertise technologique et à la qualité de son expérience de trading. Face à la croissance rapide de la demande en matière de cryptomonnaies sur le marché européen, la plateforme a désormais recentré sa stratégie sur l’Europe et accélère son expansion régionale. 1 . Se concentrer sur les besoins des utilisateurs européens : optimiser les produits et services pour améliorer l’expérience de trading des utilisateurs locaux. 2. Renforcer l’opérationnalisation locale : offrir un support multilingue et proposer des outils de trading adaptés aux besoins du marché asiatique. 3. Accélérer la vitesse d’expansion du marché : intensifier la promotion du marché et augmenter le taux de croissance des utilisateurs. Les dirigeants de Blockchain Network ont déclaré : « Le marché européen est devenu l’une des régions les plus actives en matière de trading de cryptomonnaies au niveau mondial. Nous souhaitons offrir aux investisseurs européens une expérience de trading exceptionnelle grâce à des produits innovants et des services professionnels. » Une alliance de poids, permettant d’autonomiser les investisseurs du monde entier. En tant que l’un des meilleurs analystes financiers mondiaux, Laurent Mignon est reconnu pour ses prévisions de marché précises et ses analyses approfondies des investissements, notamment dans l’analyse des tendances et les stratégies de trading innovantes. Cette collaboration avec Blockchain Network a pour objectif d’aider les investisseurs du monde entier à saisir plus précisément les opportunités du marché, à augmenter leur taux de réussite en investissement et à réaliser une croissance de leur patrimoine. Blockchain Network est une plateforme de trading de cryptomonnaies de premier plan, fortement présente en Amérique, en Asie et en Europe. Au-delà d’offrir des technologies de trading avancées, elle s’engage à réduire les coûts de transaction et à optimiser les mécanismes de mise en relation, garantissant ainsi un environnement de trading transparent et efficace pour ses utilisateurs. Cette collaboration stratégique accélérera son expansion sur le marché asiatique et renforcera davantage son influence mondiale. Détails de l’événement : ✅ Inscription = Récompense en espèces immédiate : En vous inscrivant avec le code d’invitation exclusif de Laurent Mignon, vous recevrez une récompense en espèces de 100 à 2000 dollars, sans besoin de transaction, sans conditions cachées, directement sur votre compte, et vous pourrez retirer à tout moment ! Loterie de luxe d’une valeur de 20 millions de dollars : Tous les utilisateurs de Blockchain Network peuvent participer et profiter des généreuses récompenses ! Analyse exclusive du marché et conseils stratégiques : Accédez en priorité aux rapports de recherche approfondie sur le marché et aux stratégies de trading à haut taux de réussite de Laurent Mignon Le changement dans l’industrie déclenche une nouvelle vague d’engouement pour les investissements en cryptomonnaies. Actuellement, le marché des cryptomonnaies connaît une nouvelle phase de développement rapide, avec des opportunités d’investissement qui ne cessent d’émerger. Laurent Mignon déclare : « Le cœur de l’investissement dans les actifs numériques ne réside pas seulement dans l’achat et la détention, mais dans la capacité à saisir les tendances avec précision et à générer des profits dans la volatilité. » Cette collaboration avec Blockchain Network vise à aider davantage d’investisseurs à maîtriser les bonnes méthodes pour réaliser de meilleurs rendements sur le marché des cryptomonnaies. Blockchain Network continue de mettre à niveau sa plateforme , optimiser l’expérience de trading des utilisateurs , réduire les coûts de transaction et offrir des mécanismes de mise en relation plus efficaces ainsi qu’une analyse de marché plus complète . Son marché est principalement distribué en Amérique, en Asie et en Europe . Ce développement continu, associé à des collaborations stratégiques, a non seulement renforcé la compétitivité de la plateforme en Asie , mais offrira également à tous les utilisateurs une expérience d’investissement de meilleure qualité à l’échelle mondiale .

press_release_title: The Stars Align For Incredible Showcase of Original DC Music
press_release_text: The Songwriters’ Association of Washington (SAW) will host a dynamic night of original music on Wednesday, July 16, 2025, at Hank Dietle’s Tavern in Rockville, MD. The showcase features five acclaimed singer-songwriters from the DC – Dan Kenny, Joseph Friend, Rich Morey, Rick Windon, and Know1Else (Jay Keating & Kelly Diamond) ROCKVILLE, MD – July 11, 2025 – The Songwriters’ Association of Washington (SAW) is proud to present an exciting showcase featuring five popular singer-songwriters on Wednesday, July 16, 2025, from 8:00 PM to 10:00 PM at the historic Hank Dietle’s Tavern, located at 11010 Rockville Pike, Rockville, MD 20852. Performers: Dan Kenny Dan Kenny, frontman of the Americana band “From the Dirt,” is recognized for his compelling storytelling and heartfelt songwriting. Often performing alongside mandolinist Jeff Karn and vocalist Megan Leigh, Dan Kenny’s latest release, “Colored Edge of Memory,” beautifully showcases his authentic narrative style. Joseph Friend A DMV native, Joseph Friend’s musical style merges the dynamic energy of 90’s alternative rock with other eclectic influences. Intermittently gracing festival, TV, and showcase stages for the past two decades, Joseph captivates audiences with original compositions that alternate between powerful crescendos and reflective moments. He is set to begin recording his debut album, anticipated for release in 2026. Follow Joseph on social media @friendnoise. Rich Morey Rich Morey creates music rooted in Americana, Rock, Folk, and Soul, distinguished by rhythmic fingerstyle guitar and rich baritone vocals. His latest single, “More Time,” is currently available across streaming platforms, and new releases are expected soon. Rick Windon Rick Windon is known for his engaging storytelling, humor, and warmth, drawing musical inspiration from artists such as James Taylor and Elvis Costello. His latest Nashville-produced album, “Blue Moon,” was released in late 2024. He is currently working on his next project, “Parlor Songs.” Know1Else Comprised of Jay Keating and Kelly Diamond, Know1Else delivers original Americana music characterized by rich harmonies and relatable narratives. They also host the popular SAW Songwriters’ Sessions at Hank Dietle’s Tavern. About SAW The Songwriters’ Association of Washington (SAW) provides support, community, and resources for songwriters and music lovers in the DC area and beyond. Visit SAW.org for more information. About Hank Dietle’s Tavern Established in 1950, Hank Dietle’s Tavern is a historic venue celebrated for its longstanding support of live music and the local community. press_release_title: 5 Situations Where an ILIT May Be Right for You
press_release_text: An irrevocable life insurance trust ( ILIT ) is a legal structure that allows you to transfer ownership of a life insurance policy to a trust. You specify exactly how you want the life insurance proceeds to be distributed, and the trustee, who manages the policy, ensures those wishes are carried out. Once you transfer the policy, you cannot reclaim ownership. The trust officially owns the policy while you continue to pay the premiums. However, by using an ILIT, your policy may gain several tax and legal protections that can support your estate planning goals. With this in mind, here are five situations where an ILIT might be a smart financial move. 1 1)You want to minimize estate taxes Large estates may be taxed on amounts over the federal estate tax threshold ($13.99 million per person in 2025). 1 Similarly, states with estate taxes may impose their own thresholds. Life insurance death benefits are typically included in your estate unless the policy is placed within an ILIT. However, the IRS typically requires a three-year waiting period. This means that you must not pass away within three years of placing the policy in the ILIT for the life insurance payout to be excluded from your estate. If you pass away after this period, the life insurance payout won’t count toward your estate, which can help reduce or even eliminate estate taxes. That said, you are still responsible for paying premiums on the life insurance policy. If you are in good health, you may want to consider a life insurance medical exam , which could potentially lower your premiums. 2)You want to protect your assets Your life insurance death benefit and any accumulated cash value could be at risk if you default on debt, pass away with outstanding liabilities, or have legal action taken against you. State laws vary regarding protection from creditors, but a properly structured ILIT can help shield your policy from such claims. As a result, creditors may not be able to liquidate any portion of your life insurance policy to satisfy your debts or other financial obligations. 3)You want to avoid generation-skipping transfer (GST) tax If you want to leave a gift to your children or grandchildren, an ILIT could be a good option. This is because using an ILIT may allow you to avoid the generation-skipping transfer tax (GSST), by using gifts to the trust to purchase a life insurance policy. The proceeds from the death benefit are typically excluded from your estate, which means multiple generations of your family could benefit from the money, free of both estate and GST tax. 4)You want to provide for your kids’ college education ILITs allow you to specify the conditions under which your life insurance policy pays out, including how and when the funds are distributed. This flexibility makes an ILIT an excellent vehicle for funding your children’s college education. For example, you can stipulate that a portion of the death benefit be paid out annually, to be used exclusively for tuition, textbooks, and other related costs. This approach ensures that your children receive financial support without the risk of mismanaging a large lump sum. 5)You have government benefit eligibility concerns Eligibility for government benefits such as Social Security disability income and Medicaid often requires that your total assets remain below certain thresholds. A life insurance policy could push you above that threshold, potentially disqualifying you from benefits. By placing the life insurance policy in a properly structured ILIT, the policy is no longer considered part of your assets for the purposes of benefit eligibility. This can help you maintain access to important government programs if you need them. An ILIT can address a variety of estate planning and financial objectives. From reducing estate taxes to protecting assets from creditors, an ILIT offers valuable protection. It also helps manage asset distribution in blended families, provides for college costs, and helps maintain eligibility for government benefits. To determine if an ILIT is right for you, consult with an attorney who specializes in estate planning. With the right guidance, you can structure an ILIT to enjoy the financial and legal benefits it offers. 1 IRS.gov – Estate Tax. press_release_title: TMA Chicago Midwest Chapter Announces First-Ever Symposium on High-Dollar Company Restructurings
press_release_text: Association Focused on Business Improvement Offering Afternoon Program Focused on Industry’s Largest Deals on July 22, 2025 Chicago, IL / 500NewsWire / July 10, 2025 – The Turnaround Management Association’s Chicago Midwest Chapter, focused on operational and financial turnarounds of businesses of all sizes, announces today it will stage its inaugural Large Cap Symposium on Thursday, July 22 from 2:00-7:30 Central Time. In the context of restructuring, “large cap” refers to large capitalization companies — defined as firms with over one billon dollars in annual revenue. This exclusive conference, dedicated to understanding the issues unique to large cap restructurings, will feature four dynamic panel discussions with chairs of practice groups and top-tier professionals from leading firms in law, restructuring, lending, investment banking, and transactions. The conference is expected to attract a large number of attendees from legal, financial, and consulting backgrounds who work with distressed companies. Members of the press requesting interviews about the event should contact Katlyn Weiler at [email protected] . Those interested in attending the symposium can register for this program by visiting the program website . Highlights include: Expert panels on the special considerations of large cap restructuring engagements A special interview with Judge Michael Slade, United States Bankruptcy Court, Northern District of Illinois, offering a judicial perspective on these cases Cocktails and networking to close out the afternoon David Levy, the 2025 TMA Chicago/Midwest Chapter President, and a full-time professional with Keen-Summit Capital Partners and Summit Investment Management, sums up the program as “a remarkable opportunity to connect with elite restructuring industry professionals while gaining unique insights into very large deals.” Levy continued, “the event is open to members and non-members and we welcome professionals from all backgrounds to see what the TMA Chicago Midwest has to offer.” Confirmed speakers and panel topics include: Panel 1: Unique Considerations for Large Cap Restructurings Moderator: Nathan Cook, Head of U.S. Financial Advisory, Teneo Panelists: John Castellano, Americas Co-Leader, Turnaround & Restructuring, AlixPartners Dan Hugo, Senior Managing Director, FTI Consulting Doug Spelfogel, Co-Chair Bankruptcy and Restructuring Practice, Jenner & Block James H.M. Sprayragen, Vice Chairman, Hilco Global Panel 2: Liability Management Exercise Overview Moderator: Briana Richards, EY Americas Restructuring Leader, EY Parthenon Panelists: Andrew Hede, Head of Turnaround & Restructuring Practice, Accordion Scott Meyerson, Managing Director, Restructuring & Liability Management, Lazard Brian Whittman, Managing Director, Restructuring, Alvarez & Marsal Panel 3: Insights into Distressed Finance and M&A Mega Deals Moderator: Mychal Harrison, US Turnaround and Restructuring Lead, KPMG Panelists: Jack Butler, Chief Executive Officer, Birch Lake David Hales, Managing Director, Portfolio Group, Monroe Capital John Lyons, Partner, DLA Ron Meisler, Partner, Corporate Restructuring, Skadden Panel 4 : Interview with Judge Michael Slade, United States Bankruptcy Court, Northern District of Illinois Moderated by Ross Kwasteniet, Partner, Restructuring Group, Kirkland & Ellis Cocktails and Networking with heavy hors d’oeuvres immediately following the program. About TMA Chicago/Midwest TMA Chicago/Midwest is a chapter of the Turnaround Management Association (TMA), the most professionally diverse organization in the corporate restructuring, renewal, and corporate health space. Established in 1988, TMA has nearly 10,000 members in 54 chapters worldwide, including 34 North American chapters. Members include turnaround practitioners, attorneys, accountants, advisors, liquidators, consultants, as well as academic, government employees, and members of the judiciary. TMA is about more than just turnaround. TMA members are a professional community that seeks to strengthen the global economy by working to save distressed businesses, assist management to navigate off-plan events, and help healthy companies avoid similar pitfalls.

press_release_title: Calibrate Co-Founders Featured in Modern Luxury CS “Power Players” Segment for Innovation in Software Development
press_release_text: Calibrate, a Chicago-based software design and development agency, proudly announces that co-founders Kevin P. Bolger II and Sean Doyce have been featured in Modern Luxury CS magazine’s Power Players segment. Known for its design-first approach and client-centric process, Calibrate continues to help startups and enterprises turn bold ideas into impactful digital products. Chicago, IL — July, 9th 2025 — Calibrate, a leading software design and development agency based in Chicago, is proud to announce that co-founders Kevin P. Bolger II and Sean Doyce have been featured in the Power Players segment of Modern Luxury CS magazine’s June issue. This recognition celebrates entrepreneurial leaders shaping the future of their industries through innovation, vision, and impact. With deep roots in Chicago’s growing tech ecosystem, Calibrate is known for its design-first methodology , applying visual prototyping and collaborative iteration long before development begins. This client-centric process ensures digital products exceed expectations and stay aligned with strategic goals — all while simplifying the complexities of software development. “We believe true power in our field comes from combining passion, a commitment to excellence, and innovation,” said Kevin P. Bolger II, Co-Founder of Calibrate. “These attributes can’t be rushed, are not something that can be inherited, nor can they be stolen or imitated. They can only be acquired through patience, focus, dedication, and the years it takes to master your craft. Then, of course, comes the gift of listening to a client’s vision and bringing that to life” Since its founding, Calibrate has served as a trusted partner to startups, enterprise teams, and mission-driven organizations, helping them bring bold ideas to life through intuitive design and scalable technology. As the software landscape evolves rapidly, Kevin P. Bolger II and Sean Doyce see AI as a transformative opportunity — not just for clients but for Calibrate itself. “AI is still in its early innings,” said Bolger “but will likely have one of the more profound effects on humanity in ways most cannot comprehend today. We’re using it to optimize workflows, improve decision-making, and amplify what teams can achieve with fewer resources.” Beyond technology, the Calibrate team emphasizes transparency, autonomy, and accountability within their culture. “We try to inspire those around us through our work ethic, leading by example, promoting transparency and accountability, and giving our team autonomy. In our industry, it’s imperative to have an open environment, which fosters collaboration and sparks innovation” said Bolger. Calibrate is excited about some of the new client projects they’re working on and is always eager to speak with startups and businesses about opportunities to launch new software and solve complex problems. To learn more about Calibrate and view recent work, visit www.calibrated.io . About Calibrate Calibrate Software designs and builds websites, mobile apps, and enterprise solutions in a cost effective and scalable manner. The innovative software agency boasts a myriad of clients across a broad array of sectors, including: startups, fin-tech, eCommerce, hospitality, healthcare, legal-tech, private equity, logistics, education, cyber security, and more. By employing a solution driven approach, we identify unconventional methods that enable our clients to increase revenue and optimize existing workflows through technology driven solutions. To learn more, visit www.calibrated.io . press_release_title: UniFirst: Why Work Uniforms from Reputable Suppliers Are Key to Reducing Workplace Injuries
press_release_text: Training and proper safety procedures are an essential part of keeping employees safe. However, employees also need the right gear to minimize the risk of injury and, if an accident occurs, to help protect them as much as possible. When searching for a nearby uniform company , businesses should keep in mind that good uniforms don’t just provide protection, they’re also backed by reputable suppliers who partner with employers to help select and care for their employees’ uniforms. This article explores why partnering with a reputable uniform supplier helps keep the workforce safe as employees do their jobs. Material quality and safety standard compliance High-quality materials are one of the most critical aspects of work uniforms for hazardous jobs. Lower-quality uniforms that cut corners may not offer sufficient protection against workplace hazards or may fail to meet compliance standards, such as OSHA, ANSI, and NFPA. Reputable suppliers use high-grade materials to make uniforms that ideally exceed compliance standards for maximum reassurance. Good suppliers also keep up with regulatory changes, informing employers of these changes and helping them get new uniforms as soon as possible. This proactive approach helps reduce the risk of employee injury. Proper fit and design to reduce accidents Poorly made or ill-fitting uniforms and workwear can hinder workplace efficiency and comfort, or worse, increase the risk of accidents and injuries. For instance, a mask that doesn’t seal properly won’t protect against heat or airborne hazards, and loose-fitting pants could catch on equipment, leading to injury. Reputable suppliers ensure uniforms fit properly and move the way you work. This protects employees and gives them the confidence to do their job. Suppliers can also provide specialized features, such as reinforced knees for employees who frequently need to crawl and wear down the knees of their pants faster. Good suppliers will consider these specific needs when partnering with a business. Reliable replacements to prevent wear and tear issues Even the highest-quality uniforms eventually degrade and become unsafe and non-compliant for continued use. Failing to replace uniforms before they fall below safety standards puts both the employer and employee at risk. Reputable suppliers offer clear guidelines on uniform care and use, including when to replace uniforms to avoid employees using compromised or non-compliant gear. Many suppliers also notify the employer when it may be time to replace their existing uniforms and make that process as easy as possible. This means employees will always have fresh, high-quality uniforms without safety lapses. Professional laundering to preserve professionalism and safety Without proper cleaning and maintenance, uniforms can degrade faster, lose their protective properties, or suffer damage. This can increase the risk of injury and raise costs for employers who need to replace uniforms more frequently. Reputable suppliers often offer maintenance and laundering programs or partner with companies that offer these services. They’ll ensure that uniforms are taken care of to keep them in great shape and ensure the employer always has them on time. These programs help extend the lifespan of uniforms, reduce administrative burdens, and ensure employees always have clean, well-maintained workwear. Expert customer service to help pick the best options Even with thorough research, selecting the right uniforms can be challenging. Reputable suppliers, especially those specializing in the employer’s industry, have support staff to guide purchasing decisions and answer any questions or concerns. Additionally, unexpected issues can arise. An employee’s uniform might get damaged, or regulatory changes could render existing uniforms non-compliant. Strong customer support can help businesses resolve these issues as soon as possible. A great supplier will have expert customer service ready to assist with changes, offering faster solutions through shorter travel times and face-to-face assistance when needed. The bottom line High-quality, well-fitting uniforms are a crucial first step in workplace injury mitigation. However, the best suppliers back it with exceptional customer support before and after the sale. They can help an employer select the uniforms, provide laundering and maintenance, and replace them when they degrade or fall out of compliance. Partnering with a uniform supplier that treats your business as their own creates a trusted relationship focused on keeping employees safe and compliant on the job. press_release_title: 6 Ways to Bank Like a Boss
press_release_text: Whether you’re saving for a big goal, looking for the best checking account , or just want more control over your money, smart banking habits can make a big difference. Luckily, you don’t need a C-suite salary to bank like a boss. Here are six simple ways to bank smarter, faster, and more confidently. 1-Go mobile Mobile apps make banking easier by putting your accounts at your fingertips. In just a few taps, you can: Check your balances. Move cash between accounts. Set up alerts for low balances or large transactions. Deposit checks remotely. Pay bills. Send money to friends and family. Some mobile apps also offer budgeting tools, like trackers for personal spending and saving goals. 2-Pay yourself first Want to grow savings without lifting a finger? Pay yourself first. That means prioritizing saving money before spending it on anything else. Setting up a system that automates savings helps you build your nest egg without having to think about it. Here are a few ways to do it: Automatic transfers: Schedule a recurring transfer from a checking to a savings account on a weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly basis. Just be sure to check if your bank limits the number of transfers per month. Direct deposit split: Ask your employer to send part of your paycheck to your savings account and the rest to your checking account. Round-up features: Use your bank’s round-up (also called micro-saving) feature if it has one. The feature rounds up the money you spend to the nearest dollar and deposits the spare change into your savings account. You don’t need to make huge deposits. Even small amounts can make a difference, and once it’s automatic, you don’t have to think twice. 3-Ditch fees Perhaps the best way to avoid bank fees is to find a fee-free account. These accounts typically eliminate one or more common bank fees, such as monthly maintenance and minimum balance fees. Some even offer unlimited transactions. But even fee-free accounts can have costs. Take a look at this list of standard bank fees with tips for avoiding them. ATM fee: Choosing a bank with a large ATM network minimizes the chances of you being charged for using an out-of-network ATM. Another option is to get an account with a bank that reimburses ATM fees. Overdraft fee: Some banks offer overdraft protection that covers transactions that overdraw your account for free. If yours doesn’t, you may be able to avoid overdrafts by linking your savings account or credit card to cover overdrafts or turning on low balance alerts in your mobile app. Insufficient funds or returned item fee: Banks may charge this fee when they deny a transaction because you don’t have enough money in your account. Avoid it by keeping a buffer in your account and monitoring your balance regularly. Boss move: Review your account’s fee schedule once a year so nothing sneaks up on you. 4-Look for perks Many people don’t realize that checking and savings accounts sometimes offer perks like credit cards. These benefits range from cash back to special event access to financial literacy resources. The best part is you often don’t have to do anything to earn the reward. Take cell phone protection as an example. Some banks automatically pay to repair or replace your phone if it’s damaged or stolen if you use their card or account to pay your bill. Other perks might include travel rewards, discounts on subscriptions and services, increased interest rates for multiple accounts, and referral bonuses. Digging into perks can help you benefit even more from your account. Some perks may require a premium account or specific card, so check the details. 5-Keep your credit history in mind Wherever you are on your credit journey, banks have tools and products you can use to strengthen your credit score. A secured credit card is one of the most common tools banks have to help someone build or rebuild their credit score. When you apply for a secured card, you make a one-time cash deposit. As you make on-time payments and keep balances low, your bank reports your activity to the credit bureaus, helping you boost your score. Already have good credit? Then you may want to check out reward credit cards, loans, and lines of credit. These products can help you enhance your credit profile even more. 6-Always be learning A checking or savings account (or both!) is a solid start, but it’s just the beginning. As your life changes, so will your financial goals. Later on, you might want to invest or buy a home. Knowing how banking works puts you in the driver’s seat for all of it. The best way to stay sharp? Keep learning. Your bank might offer financial workshops, credit tools, or even free counseling, so make use of them. And don’t stop there. Podcasts, blogs, and YouTube accounts can teach you everything from decoding interest rates to avoiding financial traps. Boss-level banking starts now Banking like a boss is all about how well you manage your accounts. Start with these simple steps, keep learning as you go, and you’ll stay in charge of your financial future. press_release_text: Los Angeles, California, July 04, 2025, As institutional interest in digital assets continues to rise and global retail participation grows, PUM Exchange is reinforcing its technical core to meet the needs of a dynamic, high-volume market. With a focus on scalability, resilience, and security, PUM is laying the groundwork for long-term leadership in the next generation of digital asset infrastructure. Built to Handle the Next Wave of Global Volume PUM Exchange is engineered with a multi-layered system architecture that supports low-latency order execution and high-throughput transaction processing. The platform’s custom-built matching engine has been tested to handle peak loads exceeding industry benchmarks, enabling consistent performance even during periods of extreme market volatility. By decoupling system components — including order book management, wallet operations, and real-time risk control — PUM achieves elastic scaling while maintaining high availability and fault tolerance. Security as a Foundational Principle, Not a Feature From inception, PUM Exchange has adopted a security-first development model , embedding advanced risk controls and multi-layer defenses into every part of the platform. This includes: Multi-signature cold wallet storage for institutional-grade asset custody Real-time anomaly detection and automated withdrawal risk scoring Routine third-party audits and bug bounty programs with top security researchers Granular permission management and hardware-level isolation for internal operations The platform also complies with industry-leading standards for data privacy, encryption, and operational transparency, reinforcing user trust at both individual and institutional levels. Enabling a Global User Base with Enterprise-Grade Infrastructure With users in over 80 countries, PUM Exchange is investing heavily in infrastructure upgrades across multiple geographic zones, reducing latency for traders worldwide and enabling faster API response times for institutional partners. Global CDN coverage and region-specific scaling strategies ensure smooth access even in emerging or bandwidth-limited markets. The platform’s modular back-end design also allows for rapid deployment of new features and integrations, keeping it agile and future-ready without compromising core system stability. A Platform for Serious Traders, Built with Serious Engineering PUM Exchange continues to expand its reach and capabilities, attracting professional traders, developers, and strategic partners who seek reliability over hype. As the industry moves toward consolidation and maturity, platforms with real infrastructure — not just liquidity — will define the next phase of growth. press_release_title: Power to the Platform: PUM Launches Community-First Governance Model
press_release_text: Los Angeles, California, July 04, 2025, In a bold move toward full user empowerment, PUM Exchange has introduced a community-first governance framework, enabling users to directly influence how the platform evolves. This marks a new chapter in the shift toward Web3-native infrastructure — where the user community plays a central role in shaping core platform decisions. Gone are the days of one-way decision-making. PUM is ushering in an era of collaborative control. A Platform That Listens — And Acts PUM’s governance model puts users in the driver’s seat. Through the platform’s new Governance Hub, participants can propose new features, vote on critical upgrades, and help co-create the future of PUM. This is not just token-based voting — it’s a user-centric system that rewards active, thoughtful participation. “Our users aren’t just customers — they’re collaborators,” said Allen Oliverr, Founder at PUM. “We’re building a system where the people who use the platform help decide how it should evolve.” What’s on the Ballot? Community members can propose and vote on: New token listings or removals Fee adjustments and reward program designs Distribution of treasury and growth funds Prioritization of UX/UI improvements Strategic direction for platform development This system ensures that the platform is shaped by those who engage with it most — the users themselves. Simple, Open, and Global Unlike traditional governance systems that are often overly complex or reserved for power users, PUM’s governance model is built for inclusivity. It features: A user-friendly interface Educational resources Multilingual support Low participation thresholds The platform is also committed to making governance accessible worldwide, with localized onboarding guides and support for users across Southeast Asia, Africa, Latin America, and beyond. Impact-Driven Rewards To encourage meaningful involvement, PUM offers a reputation-based reward structure. Users earn visibility and platform perks for: -Submitting quality proposals -Voting consistently -Engaging in constructive discussions These contributions are tracked and displayed through a public governance score, giving recognition to contributors who positively shape the ecosystem. From Participation to Co-Ownership Governance is not just about voting — it’s about instilling co-ownership. As the crypto landscape matures, PUM believes that sustainable platforms will be those that empower their communities to think and act like stakeholders. What’s Next? Over the coming months, PUM will expand its governance model to include: Community funding proposals Contributor bounties Cross-governance voting with partner protocols Planned enhancements to the Governance Hub include: A proposal mentorship system for first-time contributors Contributor reputation tiers and badges Real-time dashboards to track proposal impact and voter turnout PUM aims to turn governance into a living system — transparent, adaptive, and open to all. About PUM Exchange PUM Exchange is a global digital asset platform focused on innovation, transparency, and user empowerment. With products spanning spot trading, derivatives, fiat integration, and community governance, PUM is building the future of digital finance. This accomplishment underscores PUM Exchange’s unwavering commitment to operating within robust legal frameworks, enhancing user protection, and fostering sustainable growth in the rapidly evolving crypto market. Strategic Commitment to Regulatory Excellence In the face of increasingly stringent global regulations, PUM Exchange has proactively prioritized compliance, embedding regulatory best practices across its operations. The newly obtained license not only authorizes PUM to legally provide trading services within the European Economic Area (EEA) but also reflects the exchange’s dedication to transparency, security, and accountability. Bolstering User Trust and Institutional Confidence Regulatory certification enhances the platform’s ability to implement comprehensive Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC) protocols, which are crucial for safeguarding users and preventing illicit activities. For institutional investors, regulatory licensing is often a prerequisite, ensuring that the platform adheres to rigorous operational and risk management standards. This compliance milestone enables PUM Exchange to expand its service offerings within the European market, including fiat on-ramps, derivatives, and token listings, thereby providing greater access and convenience to traders. Driving Sustainable Global Expansion PUM Exchange’s acquisition of the VASP license in Europe forms part of a larger multi-jurisdictional compliance strategy. The platform is actively pursuing additional licenses in key global markets across Asia, North America, and the Middle East to facilitate seamless cross-border trading and institutional-grade services. “Our vision extends beyond compliance — it’s about building a responsible and future-ready trading ecosystem,” added Allen Oliverr. “By integrating regulation with innovation, PUM Exchange aims to be a reliable partner for users at all levels.” About PUM Exchange PUM Exchange is a global digital asset platform focused on innovation, transparency, and user empowerment. press_release_title: PUM Exchange Launches Global Creator Program to Champion Crypto Education
press_release_text: Los Angeles, California, 04 July,2025, As crypto adoption grows, one challenge remains constant: education. Today, PUM Exchange announces the launch of its Creator Incentive Program, a global initiative aimed at empowering content creators to make blockchain knowledge more accessible — and rewarding them for it. From market insights to how-to videos, social commentary to deep-dive articles, creators now have the opportunity to turn their voice into real influence — and impact. Create. Educate. Earn. The program welcomes creators across platforms like YouTube, TikTok, X (formerly Twitter), Instagram, Medium, and more. Participants can earn exclusive rewards based on engagement, creativity, and consistency. Whether you’re producing technical analysis, platform walkthroughs, or educational threads, PUM will track your impact through a unique system called SpreadPoints — a Web3-native reputation metric linked to visibility and community value. Top contributors each month will be featured on PUM’s homepage, gain early access to new products, receive exclusive NFTs, and may even be invited to join the platform as Official Brand Ambassadors. Why Content? Why Now? While many exchanges pour resources into advertising, PUM is investing in its users — specifically, those helping others understand and benefit from crypto. “We believe the next wave of adoption will be driven not by marketing, but by trusted voices in the community,” said Allen Oliverr, Head of Ecosystem Growth at PUM. “People follow people — not platforms. So we’re making it worthwhile to share, teach, and explain.” This move reflects PUM’s broader mission: to be a community-first exchange where users don’t just trade, but shape the ecosystem itself. Program Highlights – Multilingual Content Accepted: PUM encourages creators from all regions — especially Southeast Asia, LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe — to apply. – No Follower Minimums: New and micro-creators are welcome. Influence is measured by contribution quality, not vanity metrics. – Weekly Themes & Challenges: Fresh prompts and campaigns keep the program dynamic, rewarding creativity and timeliness. – Monthly Leaderboards: Top creators get featured and unlocked access to additional benefits. A Platform Powered by People PUM has always emphasized user-driven growth, from its governance token ($PUMX) to its decentralized listing votes and Learn-to-Earn Academy. This new creator program adds another dimension: narrative building. “Education and trust are the bridges between skepticism and adoption,” Oliverr added. “And we want those bridges to be built by real people — with real stories.” Get Involved Today If you’re passionate about crypto and ready to help onboard the next million users, now is your chance. Visit pumex.co/creators to learn more and start earning as a voice of the next generation of Web3. press_release_title: Nano Ex Builds Institutional-Grade Infrastructure to Power the Next Phase of Digital Asset Finance
press_release_text: California, United States ,5th July 2025 As institutional interest in digital assets grows beyond speculation into structured strategies, custody solutions, and real-world use cases, Nano Ex is establishing itself as a future-ready infrastructure provider with deep capabilities tailored for professional users. From low-latency execution to regulated custody, from prime brokerage features to tailored API integrations, Nano Ex is investing in robust backend systems and high-trust workflows to support hedge funds, market makers, family offices, and crypto-native institutions operating at scale. Execution Engine Built for Speed and Precision At the core of Nano Ex’s institutional offering is its proprietary matching engine , capable of sub-50ms round-trip latency and over 500,000 TPS (transactions per second). The engine is optimized for: High-frequency trading (HFT) strategies Low-latency arbitrage between markets and instruments Algorithmic execution based on market microstructure dynamics Connectivity is offered through FIX, REST, and WebSocket APIs , with co-location available via select data centers in Asia and Europe. These allow institutional clients to integrate directly with the order book for real-time price discovery, trade execution, and portfolio management. To ensure uninterrupted access, Nano Ex has built a multi-zone failover system , elastic order queueing, and in-memory processing buffers — all designed for institutional-grade reliability. Advanced Risk Management and Trade Controls Beyond speed, professional users demand precision and control. Nano Ex offers a suite of real-time risk monitoring tools , including: Cross-margin and isolated-margin accounts Position limits and exposure thresholds Pre- and post-trade risk checks configurable via API Granular user permissions for team-based account structures These features allow asset managers to manage both discretionary and systematic portfolios with a high degree of operational safety and regulatory auditability. In addition, the platform provides custom account structures — such as segregated sub-accounts and omnibus setups — that support complex fund operations and client account hierarchies. Regulated Custody and Asset Security Nano Ex has partnered with regulated third-party custodians in key jurisdictions to provide segregated asset storage for institutional users, with: Multi-signature cold storage using HSMs SOC 2 & ISO-certified infrastructure Insurance coverage for custodied assets (up to predefined thresholds) 24/7 asset reconciliation and audit trail access This enables institutions to satisfy internal risk mandates and compliance requirements, particularly when dealing with client capital or regulatory disclosures. Liquidity Access and Prime Brokerage Services To support capital deployment at scale, Nano Ex offers: Deep spot and derivatives liquidity , aggregated across internal books and external liquidity providers OTC desk integrations , supporting large block trades with minimal slippage Custom RFQ protocols , enabling private institutional markets Credit lines and delayed settlement terms for eligible counterparties Nano Ex is also actively building its prime brokerage division , which will offer: Unified collateral management across products Real-time PnL and exposure dashboards Integrated reporting for compliance and audit workflows These services aim to provide institutions with the capital efficiency and operational clarity needed to expand their digital asset footprint responsibly. Compliance Framework and Institutional Onboarding In recognition of the unique regulatory obligations institutions face, Nano Ex provides a dedicated onboarding process including: Enhanced due diligence (EDD) and AML support White-label KYC integration for sub-clients Custom legal frameworks for custody, execution, and settlement Account activity and tax reporting tools aligned with FATCA, CRS, and MiCA The platform is registered or in registration process with key regulatory bodies in multiple jurisdictions, maintaining a proactive dialogue with regulators to support long-term institutional engagement. Expanding the Institutional Ecosystem Nano Ex is currently working with several Tier-1 asset managers, crypto-native funds, and family offices in pilot programs for its upcoming Portfolio Management Portal (PMP) . This tool will allow institutions to: Allocate across strategies, vaults, and assets Track risk and returns in real-time Customize execution policies and permissions Integrate analytics, compliance, and custody workflows in one interface About Nano Ex Nano Ex is a global digital asset platform offering secure, scalable, and compliance-ready infrastructure for traders, builders, and institutions. With a commitment to performance, trust, and product innovation, Nano Ex serves as a backbone for the next evolution of digital finance. press_release_title: PUM Exchange Introduces Smart Trading Mode to Elevate Execution Efficiency for Pro and Retail Users
press_release_text: California, United States , 5th July 2025 PUM Exchange, a rapidly growing global digital asset trading platform, today officially launched its highly anticipated Smart Trading Mode , a cutting-edge execution framework designed to optimize order placement, minimize slippage, and enhance risk management across volatile cryptocurrency markets. The feature is now fully available to all users on both desktop and mobile platforms, supporting spot and futures trading pairs worldwide. This innovative upgrade reflects PUM Exchange’s ongoing commitment to delivering professional-grade trading tools that bridge the gap between institutional precision and retail accessibility. Transforming Trading with Adaptive Execution Technology The new Smart Trading Mode leverages advanced algorithms and real-time market data to provide a dynamic trading experience that intelligently adapts to current market conditions. It is engineered to address challenges such as price volatility, thin liquidity, and fragmented order books that commonly affect traders in digital asset markets. “In a market as fast-moving and complex as crypto, execution quality can make the difference between profit and loss,” said Allen Oliverr, Founder at PUM Exchange. “Our Smart Trading Mode empowers users — whether professional traders or everyday investors — to execute orders more efficiently and with greater confidence.” Key Features and Benefits Adaptive Order Routing The system continuously evaluates real-time order book depth, spread, and historical fill rates to route orders via the most liquid paths. This reduces the risk of partial fills and price slippage, especially on mid-cap and emerging tokens where liquidity can be fragmented. Volatility-Aware Execution Logic Smart Trading Mode automatically adjusts order types between market, limit, and post-only based on live volatility thresholds and user preferences. This feature helps prevent unintended order executions and price gaps during periods of extreme market fluctuation. Comprehensive Pre-Trade Cost Estimation Traders receive detailed insights before confirming orders, including estimated fees, expected slippage, and net exposure. This transparency facilitates informed decision-making and helps users better manage their trading costs. Institutional API Enhancements Institutional clients benefit from enhanced API endpoints that allow fine-grained control over Smart Trading Mode settings, enabling integration with proprietary trading algorithms and execution strategies to optimize performance at scale. Demonstrated Performance Gains During private beta testing and early live deployment, the Smart Trading Mode has delivered measurable improvements: On average, users experienced a 22% better execution price on volatile pairs compared to standard order placement methods. The rate of order rejections and failed limit orders during peak market hours has dropped significantly, increasing trading efficiency. Adoption among high-frequency traders (HFT) and arbitrageurs has grown rapidly, validating the feature’s effectiveness in professional use cases. A Forward-Looking Vision for Trading Innovation Smart Trading Mode is a cornerstone of PUM Exchange’s product roadmap, which emphasizes innovation, user empowerment, and market integrity. Upcoming initiatives include: Pre-configured Strategy Templates such as TWAP (Time-Weighted Average Price), Iceberg, and Grid trading, enabling users to automate complex order execution strategies. User Behavior-Linked Risk Controls that dynamically adjust margin requirements and position limits based on individual trading profiles. Auto-Close Protection mechanisms to safeguard derivatives positions in highly volatile markets. Unified Cross-Platform Portfolio Analytics to provide traders with comprehensive visibility into their holdings and performance. About PUM Exchange PUM Exchange is a global digital asset platform focused on innovation, transparency, and user empowerment. With products spanning spot trading, derivatives, fiat integration, and community governance, PUM is building the future of digital finance. Additionally, its internal liquidity programs and incentivized maker models have contributed to improved order book depth, reduced slippage, and tighter spreads across key pairs. press_release_title: PUM Exchange Launches Unified Multi-Chain Wallet to Advance Cross-Chain Crypto Asset Management
press_release_text: California ,United States, 5th July 2025 PUM Exchange, a global digital asset trading platform known for its innovation-driven approach, today officially announced the launch of its Unified Multi-Chain Wallet , a next-generation asset management system designed to simplify the storage, transfer, and interaction with digital assets across multiple public blockchain networks. The wallet marks a significant infrastructure upgrade, aiming to address one of the most pressing challenges facing crypto users today: fragmented cross-chain asset management . Solving the Cross-Chain Complexity Problem As decentralized ecosystems expand across multiple Layer 1 and Layer 2 chains, users are increasingly burdened by the need to juggle multiple wallets, bridges, gas fees, and user interfaces. PUM’s new wallet architecture introduces an integrated solution that unifies these functions into a single, secure, and intuitive interface , eliminating reliance on third-party wallets or bridges. Key Capabilities of the Unified Multi-Chain Wallet Cross-Chain Asset Management Users can view, manage, and organize digital assets across over 30 supported blockchains , including Ethereum, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Optimism, Solana, Polygon, Tron, and Bitcoin. Native support ensures faster transaction recognition, unified balances, and contextual action prompts. Integrated Swaps and Native Bridge Routing The wallet supports on-chain swapping and cross-chain bridging , allowing users to move assets seamlessly across networks without leaving the PUM environment. Smart routing algorithms detect the most cost-efficient and fastest routes in real time. Security by Design: MPC + Self-Custody Hybrid PUM incorporates Multi-Party Computation (MPC) to deliver enterprise-grade key management, ensuring private keys are never fully exposed or stored in a single location. Users retain full control of their assets, while benefiting from institution-level security protocols. Automated Gas Fee Optimization The wallet automatically recommends optimal fee levels based on network congestion, reducing failed transactions and unnecessary costs — especially critical on volatile networks like Ethereum and Solana. NFT and Token Compatibility Beyond fungible tokens, the wallet also includes support for standard NFT formats (ERC-721, ERC-1155, SPL) across multiple networks, enabling users to view and transfer NFTs directly. Positioning PUM as a Web3 Operating Layer This wallet release is not a stand-alone product, but part of PUM’s broader transformation into a Web3-native operating platform . The company’s roadmap includes deeper integration with DeFi, GameFi, and on-chain social protocols — all accessed through a single account and wallet. In the next development phases, PUM plans to introduce: Native staking and yield strategies tied to wallet-held tokens Cross-chain NFT marketplace support DApp discovery layer with WalletConnect compatibility On-chain identity and reputation modules “The future of crypto will be chain-agnostic and app-centric,” added Allen Oliverr. “We believe wallets will become the browser of Web3, and we’re building toward that reality.” Global Rollout and Access The Unified Multi-Chain Wallet is available now to all PUM Exchange users across supported jurisdictions. It can be accessed via the PUM Web Platform , as well as the updated PUM Mobile App (iOS & Android) . Migration from the legacy wallet system can be completed in a single step, with no loss of asset visibility or trading functionality. Developers and institutional clients can also access API-level support for wallet features, allowing them to build integrated trading, settlement, or custody workflows atop PUM’s architecture. About PUM Exchange PUM Exchange is a global digital asset platform focused on innovation, transparency, and user empowerment. With products spanning spot trading, derivatives, fiat integration, and community governance, PUM is building the future of digital finance. The update enables users to purchase crypto directly with Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, and regional payment rails such as SEPA (EU), UPI (India), PIX (Brazil), and others. Seamless Entry for Everyone, Everywhere Getting started with crypto shouldn’t feel like solving a puzzle. That’s why PUM has partnered with leading payment providers to offer a native, frictionless experience inside the platform. Whether you’re a first-time buyer or a seasoned trader, you can now: – Choose your local currency – Select your preferred payment method – Instantly purchase BTC, ETH, USDT, and more – Start trading within minutes — no external app required “Our goal is simple,” said Marie Kwan, Head of Product at PUM. “If you can shop online, you can now buy crypto. press_release_title: OneMain Financial: How to Plan for the Cost of a New Family Dog in Las Cruces
press_release_text: Bringing home a new dog can be a joyful and exciting decision for a family. Dogs are loving, loyal and fun to have around. But before anyone falls in love with those puppy eyes, it’s important to be prepared for how much it costs to own a dog. Once the costs are clear, it’s also important to think about how to afford them. Some families explore options like loans in Las Cruces to help cover the expenses associated with caring for a dog. Whether a family is ready to move forward now or just starting to plan ahead, here’s what they need to know about the costs involved in caring for a new four-legged family member. Budget for adoption or breeder fees The first big decision is whether to adopt from a shelter or buy from a breeder. Adoption fees usually range from $50 to $300. Buying from a breeder can cost anywhere from $500 to over $5,000 depending on the breed. One place to check in Las Cruces is the Animal Services Center of the Mesilla Valley, which, as a city and county open-admission municipal shelter, offers low-cost adoptions, vaccines and microchipping. Consider the price of basic supplies As soon as a new dog comes home, some essential supplies will be needed to keep it safe, healthy, and happy. Feeding a dog is a regular expense. The cost really depends on the dog’s size and breed. Small dogs might need around $275 worth of food each year, while larger breeds could cost up to $800 annually in food and treats. Families may pay between $150 and $350 for basics like a leash, collar, ID tags, food bowls, brush, dog toothpaste, shampoo and a bed. Depending on the size, a dog crate or kennel may cost an additional $50 to $200. And don’t forget about cleaning supplies. Prepare for healthcare and grooming needs Just like people, dogs need regular checkups and vaccines. The first vet visit might include: A physical exam Vaccinations A heartworm test Flea and tick prevention Spay or neuter surgery First-year veterinary costs can range from $215 to $400. After that, yearly checkups might cost between $150 and $520, not including emergency care. Unexpected emergencies, surgeries or long-term health problems could end up costing hundreds or even thousands of dollars, so it could be helpful to start an emergency fund for this purpose. Looking into pet insurance or payment plans with a local vet may also be worthwhile. Some vet offices may also offer wellness plans or annual memberships that help spread out costs across the year. Keeping up with grooming may be another important part of a dog’s overall health. Some dogs need regular grooming, especially those with long or curly coats. Grooming can include baths, haircuts, nail trims and brushing. While some families choose to do basic grooming at home, professional grooming may still be needed every 6 weeks or so. Annual grooming costs can range from $50 to $500 depending on the dog’s needs. Breeds like poodles, doodles and shih tzus often require more grooming than short-haired dogs. Think through training and socializing Training helps dogs behave well at home and in public. It also helps them feel safe and secure. There are several types of training options: Group classes: $150 to $250 for 6–8 sessions Private lessons: $100 to $130 per hour While puppies benefit the most, older dogs can learn too. Investing in training early can save money, time and stress later on. Some families also sign up for dog walking or doggy daycare services if they’re away from home during the day, which might help their dog become more comfortable with other dogs and people, too. Save extra for surprise bills Dogs often come with extra costs that may not be obvious at first, especially to new pet owners. These could include: City or state license fees (about $5–$20 per year) Paying for pet-sitting or boarding while traveling Buying dog clothes for winter, puzzle toys for stimulation or agility gear for outdoor adventures Plan ahead for peace of mind Whether it’s an energetic puppy or a calm older dog, bringing a pet into the home is exciting, but it also comes with a variety of new, and potentially expensive, responsibilities. Providing a good home for a dog doesn’t take a huge income, but making a budget and saving in advance can make things easier. By planning ahead and understanding the costs, families can be better financially prepared, make sure the dog has everything it needs to live a happy and healthy life and enjoy the fun that comes with having a furry companion. press_release_title: 6 Important Dental Insurance Terms You Should Know
press_release_text: Regular dental care is crucial to maintaining healthy teeth. Dental insurance helps you cover the costs of your care, from routine cleanings to major work. However, dental insurance plans contain several features and terms to know. Understanding these can help you feel more confident in the process of getting a policy and answer questions like “ what does an annual maximum mean for dental insurance ?” With that in mind, this article explains six important dental insurance terms to know. 1-Premium Your premium is the price you pay to maintain coverage. Providers typically bill monthly or annually, and some may offer a small discount for annual payments. Dental insurance premiums tend to cost less than traditional health insurance, since it’s a form of supplemental insurance. However, your premiums depend on several factors: Coverage amounts: Higher coverage amounts will require higher premiums. Deductibles: Deductibles correlate inversely with premiums. Lower deductibles require higher premiums and vice-versa. Provider network: Policies with wider provider networks may cost more. Policy type: Different policy types may charge varying premiums to account for differences in flexibility and other benefits. Insurance provider: Insurers vary in how they calculate premiums and may be in different financial situations. Therefore, each insurer may charge different amounts for the same coverage. 2- Deductible The deductible is the amount your policy requires you to pay out of pocket before the insurer begins covering the costs. For example, imagine you have a $200 deductible for a treatment that costs $300. That means you must pay $200 out of pocket before your insurance helps with the remaining $100. As mentioned, premiums and deductibles are inversely correlated. Raising one lowers the other and vice-versa. Furthermore, some services — usually preventive care, like routine cleanings — are not subject to deductibles. Coverage kicks in immediately. This means people who only need routine care may opt for a higher deductible to save on premiums. Meanwhile, someone needing frequent care and more complex procedures may prefer higher premiums for a lower deductible. 3-Copayment and coinsurance Copayments and coinsurance are two ways you may share the cost of coverage with your insurer. A copayment is a fixed cost you pay for a service. For example, your dental insurance may require $10 for a routine appointment that includes an oral exam and cleaning. Coinsurance is a percentage of a service’s total cost you must pay. For example, your insurer may require you to pay 20% of the cost of a basic service. The insurer then covers the rest. If your services require a deductible, you must meet that deductible first before coinsurance kicks in. 4-Provider network Insurance companies negotiate contracts with dental providers to perform services for the company’s policyholders. In exchange, the insurer provides coverage and reimbursement to policyholders who visit these dental providers. This supplies the dental provider with a steady stream of patients while giving the patients access to inexpensive care. This list of dental providers is called the provider network. Visiting providers in-network, or within the provider’s network, qualifies you for the maximum coverage amount under your plan. Dental Paid Provider Organizations (DPPOs) may offer some reimbursement for out-of-network providers, but you’ll get the most coverage in-network. Meanwhile, Dental Health Maintenance Organizations (DHMOs) seldom offer reimbursement for visits to out-of-network providers. Either way, insurers differ in their provider networks even under the same kinds of dental plans. 5-Waiting period A waiting period is a specified timeframe where coverage is not active. Insurers use these to prevent people from purchasing plans right after discovering they have a dental problem since insurance is meant to be a layer of security. Many dental plans don’t have waiting periods for preventive care. Meanwhile, basic and major procedures may have waiting periods whose lengths vary by insurer and coverage levels. Waiting periods tend to be shorter or nonexistent with higher-priced plans. If you need a procedure during that procedure’s waiting period, such as emergency care, you’ll likely have to pay the full cost out of pocket. 6-Annual maximum An annual maximum for dental insurance is the highest dollar amount that an insurance plan will pay for covered dental services in a given year. Once you reach this limit, you’re responsible for paying any additional costs for dental care out of pocket. The annual maximum will reset at the beginning of each new policy year. These limits can vary depending on your specific insurance plan and provider. The bottom line Dental insurance can significantly improve your dental health by encouraging you to visit the dentist. However, understanding the terminology is key to getting the right policy. Premiums, deductibles, copayments and coinsurance, provider networks, waiting periods, and annual maximums are some of the most important features to know. Now that you know these terms, you can shop more confidently for a dental plan that fits your needs and budget.
